Share a pizza

Inspired by Loreto’s Pizzeria, credited to @laloreto in the historical inventory (page 9). This sharing puzzle is new for the prototype. There is no pizzeria building, ordering, or purchase.

Split the slices

Choose four slices for one plate; the other four go on the second plate. Put two mushroom and two pepper slices on each plate. Split each of these opposite pairs between the plates:

  • 1 (Mushroom) and 5 (Pepper)
  • 2 (Pepper) and 6 (Mushroom)
  • 3 (Mushroom) and 7 (Pepper)
  • 4 (Pepper) and 8 (Mushroom)

More than one arrangement works. Try it on paper, aloud, or with the optional controls.

Try the slice controls

Choose a slice again to return it to the second plate.

Read one solution

Put slices 1, 2, 3, and 4 on the first plate. That gives it two mushroom and two pepper slices, and leaves the opposite member of every pair for the second plate. Try swapping both slices 1 and 2 with their opposite slices; the plates still balance.
